title: Vegan Poutine Recipe
summary: My vegan poutine recipe turn crispy French fries, savory vegan gravy, and gooey dairy-free cheese curds into the ultimate plant-based comfort food. I love how the hot gravy softens some of the fries w…
ingredients: 1 serving French fries (about 2 pounds of potatoes (homemade or store bought)
½ serving vegan gravy (about 1 cup but can use more for extra saucy)
½ serving cheese curds (about 1 cup (homemade or store bought)
steps: Make French fries if making homemade by following the recipe directions.
Divide the fries onto four plates.
Garnish with parsley and chives if preferred.
author: Anjali Shah
